outcome: Typed reports express every required identity, provenance, population, metric, and episode field.

artifacts.purpose: RunManifest, RunReport envelope, check/receipt/inspection identity types

interfaces: Caller supplies UUIDv7 identity/time and exact digests; report assembly does not fetch time/files.
Fields raw/final/probability/signals carry the concrete task kind; no universal dynamic metric map.
Source definitions in reports use bound stored evidence paths; prediction snapshot stays unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: All specified top-level fields and per-label/episode evidence are present, including not_applicable metric families.
Composition and counts include zero-count unused sources, correct selected/unselected population, and normalization diagnostics.
Routine report never contains input or raw evidence; opaque configuration remains as explicitly required.

verification.expected: Complete, hard-label-only, empty and evidence-bearing-abstention variants validate.
Counts/source rewrites correct; opaque input sentinel absent.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
